description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -Karuwalagahaagara, Kotavehera D/S Division, Kurunegala District (25/0256)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters, including declarations of title determination for specific land parcels, registration under the Registration of Title Act, and detailed schedules showing land ownership (primarily by "The State" and local government bodies). The content falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
